svg.title: 五段階・四つの資金ゲート — Five Stages, Four Funding Gates
svg.desc: A flow diagram showing five stages separated by four funding gates, progressing from concept to completion.
svg.text: 五段階・四つの資金ゲート
資金ゲート (Funding gate) — go / no-go decision
Each gate (ゲート) is a funding decision point — pass to proceed, stop to re-evaluate
